      "channel_name": "Interaction", // Maps to Encord labeling ontology
      "annotation_type": "LANGUAGE",
      "events": [
        {
          "event_uuid": "973fcc09-fbe5-4d3c-9f10-cf3819eb417a",  // label

Hi Roger, 

Thanks so much for following up. Let us get back to you but the main issue/challenge is ensuring high quality across multiple datasets as the quality varies significantly. We also have the option to custom collect data for the vendor and can ramp this up with our partners depending on your customer's timeline. 

Separately, I also wanted to follow up on part of your other request. We do have off-the-shelf audio data. Details below. Pricing is roughly $2.50 per hour depending on volume. Samples here

Dataset overview

• 

Type of data: Anonymised multi-channel audio recordings of real-world business conversations, primarily 1:1 calls between businesses and their customers or between two businesses, with a smaller share of multi-party conference calls.

• 

Scale: ~10 million hours of audio suitable for model training.

• 

Geography: Global coverage, with most interactions originating from Europe, North America, and Australia.

• 

Topics / use cases: Calls span a broad range of business functions, including:

• 

Training & education, demos, recruitment, interviews, assessments

• 

Marketing, sales, client interactions

• 

Support, inbound/outbound, screening, follow-up

• 

General admin and other operational conversations

• 

Languages: English (majority of volume), Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Swedish, Finnish.

• 

Audio format & structure:

• 

Source captured as 3 channels: Left (Speaker 1), Right (Speaker 2), and a merged mix.

• 

Delivered as separate files per channel (L, R, merged), in MP3 format.

• 

Transcripts & timing:

• 

Full transcripts are available (machine generated)

• 

Each conversation has an associated JSON file with timestamps for the dialogue; 

• 

Metadata (per call) - subject to PII redaction

• 

Phone numbers (source and target)

• 

Call duration

• 

Call direction (inbound / outbound)

• 

Telco outcome (e.g. successful call)

• 

Internal vs external call flag

• 

Category / description of call

subject: RE: Flikweert Vision & Encord | Path forward
text:
Hi Kamil,

Apologies for coming back to this once more. While reviewing the agreement in more detail, there is one point that I need to address because it is essential for us.

Section 4.3 grants Encord a worldwide, royalty-free licence over all Client Input. Given the nature of our business and the value of the data we will be putting into the platform, this is something we simply cannot agree to. Our data is a core strategic asset, and we cannot allow any contractual interpretation that would give Encord rights to use, analyse, reuse or benefit from that data beyond what is strictly required to operate the service for us.
Joas mentioned that the intention on your side is that:

  *   Flikweert Vision always remains the sole owner of all data; and
  *   Encord will not use our data for any purpose other than delivering the service to us (and will not use it for model training, product improvement, or for other customers).
If that is indeed our shared understanding, then the agreement needs to reflect it explicitly.
The current wording in 4.3 does not provide that clarity.

To be clear:
We are not willing to grant any broad or open-ended licence over our data. The only rights Encord should receive are the minimal, strictly necessary technical rights to host and process our data solely for the purpose of providing the service to Flikweert Vision.

Could you please update the contract and add the following accordingly so that it is unambiguous that:

  1.  Encord receives no rights to Client Input beyond what is required to technically operate the service;
  2.  Client Input will never be used to train models, improve Encord’s products, or be shared (even in anonymised form) outside our own tenancy; and
  3.  All ownership and substantive rights remain exclusively with Flikweert Vision.
  4.
Thanks for your understanding
I’m sure we can resolve this easily once the wording is aligned with our intention.

Kind regards,

Martijn Flikweert
Co-Founder & CEO
